column1: # Quick plan on amd64 (a VMware cloud VM, 8 vCPU Xeon Gold 6248R), step 1: as quick/1-pool.tsv, longer cells. Step 0
# there (oxidestack/docx-to-pdf, 2026-10-22): batches of 40 conversions varied 3.9-4.3 % in
# throughput and 3.3-3.7 % in p95, the cloud's neighbours moving throughput ±5 % from one minute to the next; batches of
# 120-160 came under 2.5 % at 4 vCPU. So N = 120 + 3·VUs, rounded up to whole rounds of the four documents;
# moalhaddar/docx-to-pdf takes the same N (the noise is the VM's). --reps 2.
